source: Existing CN calculator assets; copied unchanged, without network access.
reproduction: --assets-root defaults to ../assets next to the supplied runtime data directory.
pathMapping: ./assets/<relative path> maps to <assets-root>/<relative path>; names and subdirectories are preserved.

mappings.skills: src/data/wish-power-icons.js, local runtime icon/asset URLs, optional skills/manifest.json, then matching skill-ID filenames

upstreamLicenses.note: Game images retain their original rights. This file records provenance, not a new license grant.

missingImagePolicy: Unavailable local avatars and skill icons are null; the UI must render its fallback.
